name: naffo
description: Naffo ERP assistant for Claude Code — guided workflows and skills for day-to-day operations (invoices, payments, stock, dairy procurement, CRM, reports) and business planning (demand forecasting, production planning, inventory optimization, stock transfer recommendations).

naffo.note: Shared OAuth 2.1 endpoint — no token goes in this URL. Claude Code discovers the authorization server from /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource and signs each user in through their browser. Scopes: read, write, destructive.
